Description: As a shopper, I want to browse grocery categories so that I can discover relevant products.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Description: As a shopper, I want to search by product name so that I can find an item quickly.
Acceptance Criteria: Given the catalogue contains milk, When I search for milk, Then matching products are displayed.

Description: As a shopper, I want to filter results by brand and price range so that I can narrow my choices.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Description: As a shopper, I want to view price, size and availability so that I can make an informed choice.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Description: As a shopper, I want to add an available item to my cart so that I can purchase it later.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an available product, When I select Add to Cart, Then the cart shows the product and quantity one.

Description: As a shopper, I want to increase or decrease an item's quantity so that my cart matches my needs.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Description: As a shopper, I want to enter and save a delivery address so that my order reaches the correct location.
Acceptance Criteria: Given checkout is open, When I submit a complete valid address, Then the address is saved for this order.

Description: As a shopper, I want to pay using an available payment method so that I can complete my purchase.
Acceptance Criteria: Given valid cart and address details, When payment is approved, Then an order confirmation is created. Given payment is declined, When the payment response is received, Then no successful order is shown and I can retry.

Description: As a shopper, I want an order number and summary after checkout so that I know my order was placed.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Description: As a shopper, I want to see packed, dispatched and out-for-delivery states so that I know the progress of my order.
Acceptance Criteria: Given my order has been dispatched, When I open Track Order, Then the latest delivery state and update time are displayed.

Description: As a shopper, I want delivery notifications so that I can prepare to receive my groceries.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.

Description: As a shopper, I want to report a missing or damaged item so that support can resolve the issue.
Acceptance Criteria: See set report for Given/When/Then acceptance criteria.
